name: What types of flooring are best for rental properties in terms of durability and maintenance?

mainEntity.name: What types of flooring are best for rental properties in terms of durability and maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: For rental properties, durable and low-maintenance flooring options are key. Vinyl plank flooring (LVP) is a popular choice due to its water resistance, durability, and cost-effectiveness, mimicking the look of wood or tile. Ceramic or porcelain tile is excellent for kitchens and bathrooms, offering high resistance to wear and moisture. While carpet can be comfortable, it requires more frequent replacement and cleaning. The best choice often balances initial cost, longevity, and appeal to potential tenants.
acceptedAnswer.description: Durable and low-maintenance options like vinyl plank (LVP) and ceramic/porcelain tile are excellent for rental properties due to their resistance and longevity.
